blocked.label: Blocked by audit
blocked.hint: The audit blocked this release, for example for suspected malware or a broken archive.

private-data.label: Reads private data
private-data.hint: The audit found code that may access Steam login data, SSH keys or secrets from the environment.

persistence.label: Changes system startup
persistence.hint: The audit found code that may change shell profiles, preloaded libraries, kernel modules or device rules. Such changes can keep working outside Decky.

not-in-source.label: Very high risk: Download includes code that is not in GitHub
not-in-source.hint: The downloaded release contains code the audit could not match to the published source. This could hide malicious changes. Review the release before installing; a mismatch does not prove malware.

obfuscated.label: Hidden code
obfuscated.hint: The audit found encoded or packed code that's hard to read.

no-tls-check.label: Skips HTTPS checks
no-tls-check.hint: The audit found code that turns off certificate checks, so what it downloads could be tampered with.

runs-downloads.label: Runs downloaded scripts
runs-downloads.hint: The audit found code that downloads a script and runs it straight away.

vulnerable.label: Known vulnerabilities
vulnerable.hint: The audit found bundled libraries with published security flaws.
